knight.name: Knight
knight.desc: An oathbound shield. Tougher armor, punishing zones of control.

berserker.name: Berserker
berserker.desc: Grows deadlier with every foe that falls.

assassin.name: Assassin
assassin.desc: Strikes from nowhere and is gone again.

warden.name: Warden
warden.desc: Master of overwatch and area denial.

pyromancer.name: Pyromancer
pyromancer.desc: Fire that falls where it will and spreads.

oracle.name: Oracle
oracle.desc: Sees a moment ahead. Stronger heals and steady allies.

harpooneer.name: Harpooneer
harpooneer.desc: Hooks its prey and never lets go.

beaconkeeper.name: Beaconkeeper
beaconkeeper.desc: A living lighthouse against the Hush.

archivist.name: Archivist
archivist.desc: Keeps every name, and every friend, from fading.

oakheart.name: Oakheart
oakheart.desc: An ancient guardian that shelters its grove.

briarlord.name: Briarlord
briarlord.desc: Every step toward it draws blood.

dunestrider.name: Dunestrider
dunestrider.desc: Here, then gone beneath the sand.

glasswright.name: Glasswright
glasswright.desc: Blades as sharp as they are fragile.
